Explore released datasets and analysis code associated with GRID. Each highlight describes a product's scope, creators, access route, and citation. Dates shown are repository release dates; related articles may have different publication dates.

Start with [Data Access](data-access.qmd) for direct downloads, [Coverage](coverage.qmd) for the relationship to the wider inventory, or [Contribute Data](contribute-data.qmd) to discuss a new contribution.
